security_spec.violation_condition: QEMU's TCG translator allows vfwcvtbf16.f.f.v or vfncvtbf16.f.f.w at SEW=8 without gating on the Zvfofp8min extension; the existing SEW=16 BF16 helpers would be incorrectly invoked on 8-bit OFP8 data, or conversely, properly implementing the SEW=8 OFP8 path without the extension gate exposes OFP8 conversion semantics to guests that do not implement the extension, violating the architectural ISA contract and allowing a malicious guest to craft OFP8 bit patterns that exploit any discrepancy between the emulated and architectural NaN/rounding behavior
security_spec.vulnerability_pattern: SEW=8 path in vfwcvtbf16/vfncvtbf16 trans functions not guarded by REQUIRE_ZVFofp8min; or altfmt SEW=8 routing mapping to Zvfbfa instead of Zvfofp8min in require_zvfh/require_zvfhmin/require_scale_rvf
security_spec.summary: SEW=8 altfmt-sensitized reuse of existing BF16 conversion instructions creates dual-semantic encoding where TCG may route OFP8 conversions through BF16 helpers without extension gating, leaking OFP8 NaN payloads or producing architecturally-invisible results
